sections.title: باب 6 — متن (4)

paras.text: … the winning party or parties form the government according to law. Today at the world level the way of reaching government is support from the majority of the public. When a party forms the government, it then tries through governmental power to give practical shape to its programme. If any party fails to give practical form to its programme, it has to face a bad defeat in the next elections. Throughout the world this is the popular method of government formation. A government formed through political parties is a people’s government.

paras.text: For the formation of any effective and stable political system and democratic society the existence of an opposition is of extreme importance. The opposition reminds the governing party of its manifesto, programme and the promises made to the public. If the governing party exceeds its powers and legal limits, the opposition criticises it severely and tries to keep it within its sphere. It is a check on the governing party. The tragedy in developing countries is that neither does the governing party tolerate the opposition nor does the opposition play its legitimate role; rather the aim of the opposition is to defame the governing party by any means, and their one aim is “opposition for the sake of opposition”.

… the winning party or parties form the government according to law. Today at the world level the way of reaching government is support from the majority of the public. When a party forms the government, it then tries through governmental power to give practical shape to its programme. If any party fails to give practical form to its programme, it has to face a bad defeat in the next elections. Throughout the world this is the popular method of government formation. A government formed through political parties is a people’s government.

For the formation of any effective and stable political system and democratic society the existence of an opposition is of extreme importance. The opposition reminds the governing party of its manifesto, programme and the promises made to the public. If the governing party exceeds its powers and legal limits, the opposition criticises it severely and tries to keep it within its sphere. It is a check on the governing party. The tragedy in developing countries is that neither does the governing party tolerate the opposition nor does the opposition play its legitimate role; rather the aim of the opposition is to defame the governing party by any means, and their one aim is “opposition for the sake of opposition”.

Political parties play a two-way role. On one side they convey the problems of the public to the government, while on the other … and activities to the public. They are a means of mutual contact, and this contact is of importance for the stability and improvement of the political system. In a state, especially in multi-ethnic states, sometimes small ethnic groups are not able to obtain representation as a result of general elections. They have no representation in national politics and their problems are not solved. In such circumstances such small and unrepresented ethnic groups become pressure groups and try to get their problems solved from this same platform. Such groups ultimately change into political parties. These parties then present the problems of these nationalities effectively.

Generally a political party is made up of four elements, i.e. manifesto, constitution, volunteers and leadership. These four elements of any political party are the cause of unity within the party.

paras.text: A political party collects the most important problems of the country and from these problems selects the problems of urgent and severe nature. Keeping these problems in view, political parties prepare their manifesto or programme. The leadership approves this manifesto. A manifesto is that programme of a political party through which parties increase their workers and bring people into political parties. On the basis of this manifesto political parties take part in elections, and after winning elections, forming the government, give practical shape to their manifesto. In the light of this manifesto policy-making and law-making are done. A manifesto is in fact the name of that detailed programme which is prepared in the light of the wishes and psychology of people. The success of a political party depends on the attractiveness and magnetism of its manifesto. Those manifestos are successful which are about national affairs and problems of urgent importance. Some political parties prepare manifestos keeping in view regional interests and ethnic, class and sectarian interests. Political parties of this kind generally remain away from the mainstream of national politics. Manifesto-making is a difficult and sensitive matter. … are alike. Every party is completely organised from bottom to top and has its own office-bearers. Every party has its own flag, ideology and political slogan. Generally a political party is made up of four elements, i.e. manifesto, constitution, volunteers and leadership. These four elements of any political party are the cause of unity within the party.

1. Manifesto:

A political party collects the most important problems of the country and from these problems selects the problems of urgent and severe nature. Keeping these problems in view, political parties prepare their manifesto or programme. The leadership approves this manifesto. A manifesto is that programme of a political party through which parties increase their workers and bring people into political parties. On the basis of this manifesto political parties take part in elections, and after winning elections, forming the government, give practical shape to their manifesto. In the light of this manifesto policy-making and law-making are done. A manifesto is in fact the name of that detailed programme which is prepared in the light of the wishes and psychology of people. The success of a political party depends on the attractiveness and magnetism of its manifesto. Those manifestos are successful which are about national affairs and problems of urgent importance. Some political parties prepare manifestos keeping in view regional interests and ethnic, class and sectarian interests. Political parties of this kind generally remain away from the mainstream of national politics. Manifesto-making is a difficult and sensitive matter. In every party there is a research cell which, after research and deliberation, prepares the draft of the manifesto. For this, wide knowledge and experience are needed. Sometimes this manifesto is prepared on the basis of a particular region, ethnicity, province or language etc. In this way this party then affects elections and the distribution of powers with another reference.

2. Constitution:

The constitution of a party is the name of that document which tells us about the structure and composition of the political party. The constitutions of parties explain how the office-bearers of the party will be elected, for how long a period it will be, etc. This same constitution also makes clear their powers and the procedure of dismissal. They do not only provide information about the leadership but describe in detail the structure of all party institutions from top to bottom. It is not a formal document; rather all the office-bearers and workers of the party respect it and abide by it. If any office-bearer or member violates the party constitution, he is punished and even expelled from the party. This constitution keeps a political party organised. کسی جماعت کا آئین اُس دستاویز کا نام ہے جو ہمیں سیاسی جماعت کی ساخت اور بناوٹ کے بارے میں بتاتا ہے۔ جماعتوں کے دستور اِس بات کی وضاحت کرتے ہیں کہ جماعت کے عہدیداروں کا اِنتخاب کس طرح ہوگا؟ کتنی مدت کیلئے ہوگا؟ وغیرہ وغیرہ۔ یہی آئین اُنکے اِختیارات اور برطرفی کا طریقہ کار بھی واضح کرتا ہے۔ یہ صرف قیادت کے بارے میں معلومات فراہم نہیں کرتے بلکہ اُوپر سے نیچے تک تمام جماعتی اِداروں کی ساخت تفصیل سے بیان کرتے ہیں۔ یہ ایک رسمی دستاویز نہیں بلکہ جماعت کے تمام عہدیدار اور کارکن اِس کا اِحترام اور پابندی کرتے ہیں۔ اگر کوئی عہدیدار یا رُکن پارٹی آئین کی خلاف ورزی کرے تو اُسے سزا دی جاتی ہے اور یہاں تک کہ پارٹی سے خارج کر دیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ آئین سیاسی جماعت کو منظم رکھتا ہے۔ وہی جماعتیں زیادہ مؤثر اور کامیاب ہوتی ہیں جو اپنے آئین پر عمل کرتی ہیں۔ جن جماعتوں کے …
